## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] Relevant search results or CLI output were checked manually

## Compatibility

- [ ] Structured YAML and JSON output remains compatible, or the breaking change is documented
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md was updated when appropriate
